caseName: Town of Chino Valley v. City of Prescott
caseNameFull: Town of Chino Valley v. City of Prescott

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ariz. Motion of Arizona for leave to intervene as a party appellee granted. Appeal dimissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this case.
